The '''Cherry Bomb''' is a one-time use [[Crafting#Bombs|explosive item]]. It damages certain items within its radius.  Other items are impervious to its effects.

Cherry Bombs can be [[Crafting|crafted]] or purchased from the [[Dwarf]] (both in the [[Volcano Dungeon]] and [[The Mines]]) for {{Price|450}}.  They can also be dropped by [[Rock Crab]]s or [[Duggy|Duggies]] when slain. Fifteen Cherry Bombs may occasionally be found in [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure rooms]] in the Skull Cavern. [[The Mines#Crates and Barrels|Crates and barrels]] in the [[The Mines#Difficulty Levels|"dangerous" Mines]] or [[Skull Cavern]] can drop one. 3-5 Cherry Bombs may occasionally be found in [[Supply Crate]]s on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] if the player has not upgraded the [[Farmhouse]] yet. A Cherry Bomb may occasionally be purchased from the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|50}}. Twenty Cherry Bombs can be given as the 10th prize from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|prize machine]] in the Mayor's Manor (33% chance). [[Kent]] may randomly send one in the mail as a gift.

If a player has read the [[Dwarvish Safety Manual]], they will take 25% less damage from a Cherry Bomb.

==Bundles==
Cherry Bomb is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
A Cherry Bomb can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[File:Shirt155.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Bomber Jacket]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a red dye at the dye pots located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. It can also be used as a red dye when used in the spool of the [[Sewing Machine]] with a dyeable clothing item in the feed.

==Quests==
Cherry Bomb is not used in any [[quests]].
